library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)






# 7.1. Import metadata & predictions


data_dir    <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results"

patient_info_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "patient_info_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# All prediction files
classifier_files <- tibble(
  classifier = c("Full LASSO", "3-feature LASSO", "1-feature LASSO", "FABP4", "ISG15"),
  csv = c(
    "lassoRF_preds.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_n3.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_n1.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_FABP4.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_ISG15.csv"
  ),
  suffix = c("prot", "n3_prot", "n1_prot", "FABP4_prot", "ISG15_prot")
)

pred_list <- classifier_files %>%
  mutate(
    preds = lapply(csv, function(f) {
      read.csv(file.path(results_dir, f), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
        mutate(
          LRTI_adjudication = factor(
            LRTI_adjudication,
            levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
          )
        ) %>%
        inner_join(
          patient_info_with_folds %>% select(patient_id, fold),
          by = "patient_id"
        )
    })
  )






# 7.2. AUC helper function


output_auc_roc <- function(preds_df, output_suffix) {

  # Per-fold AUC
  auc_df <- preds_df %>%
    group_by(fold) %>%
    summarize({
      roc_obj <- pROC::roc(
        response = factor(LRTI_adjudication,
                          levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")),
        predictor = pred,
        direction = "<"
      )

      ci_vals <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)

      tibble(
        auc = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
        auc_lower = ci_vals[1],
        auc_upper = ci_vals[3]
      )
    }, .groups = "drop")

  # Fold ROC PDF
  pdf(file.path(results_dir, paste0("ROC_", output_suffix, ".pdf")))

  for (i in sort(unique(preds_df$fold))) {

    fold_data <- preds_df %>% filter(fold == i)

    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(
      response = factor(fold_data$LRTI_adjudication,
                        levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")),
      predictor = fold_data$pred,
      direction = "<"
    )

    plot(roc_obj, add = (i != 1), col = i)
  }

  dev.off()

  write.csv(
    auc_df,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("cv_auc_", output_suffix, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Pooled ROC + DeLong CI
  pooled_roc <- pROC::roc(
    response = factor(preds_df$LRTI_adjudication,
                      levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")),
    predictor = preds_df$pred,
    direction = "<"
  )

  ci_auc <- pROC::ci.auc(pooled_roc)

  pooled_summary <- data.frame(
    auc   = as.numeric(ci_auc[2]),
    lower = ci_auc[1],
    upper = ci_auc[3]
  )

  write.csv(
    pooled_summary,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("pooled_auc_", output_suffix, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  list(
    fold_auc = auc_df,
    pooled = pooled_summary
  )
}






# 7.3. Run all five classifiers

auc_results <- pred_list %>%
  mutate(
    results = Map(output_auc_roc, preds, suffix)
  )

# Full LASSO objects retained for downstream sections
merged_preds <- pred_list$preds[[1]]
auc_lassoRF  <- auc_results$results[[1]]$fold_auc






# 7.4. Full LASSO summary

ci_auc <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "pooled_auc_prot.csv"))

message(
  "Full LASSO AUC: ",
  round(ci_auc$auc, 2),
  " (95% CI: ",
  round(ci_auc$lower, 2),
  "–",
  round(ci_auc$upper, 2),
  ")"
)

print(auc_lassoRF)






# 7.5. Forest plot – all protein classifiers


forest_data_prot <- auc_results %>%
  transmute(
    classifier,
    auc   = sapply(results, function(x) x$pooled$auc),
    lower = sapply(results, function(x) x$pooled$lower),
    upper = sapply(results, function(x) x$pooled$upper)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    classifier = factor(
      classifier,
      levels = c(
        "ISG15",
        "FABP4",
        "1-feature LASSO",
        "3-feature LASSO",
        "Full LASSO"
      )
    )
  )

forest_plot_prot <- ggplot(forest_data_prot, aes(y = classifier)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = auc), size = 4, shape = 18) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    height = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = upper + 0.03,
      label = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", auc, lower, upper)
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 1.15),
    breaks = seq(0.5, 1.0, 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "AUROC Comparison Across Protein Classifiers",
    subtitle = "Point estimates with 95% DeLong confidence intervals",
    x = "AUROC",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica", face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "plain", size = 11)
  )

print(forest_plot_prot)

ggsave(
  file.path(results_dir, "forest_plot_protein_classifiers.pdf"),
  forest_plot_prot,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)

write.csv(
  forest_data_prot,
  file.path(results_dir, "forest_data_protein_classifiers.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)






# 7.6. Full LASSO vs 3-protein classifier ROC curves


# Prepare predictions from objects already created in 7.1
lassoRF_preds_lambda <- pred_list$preds[[which(classifier_files$classifier == "Full LASSO")]]

lassoRF_preds_n3 <- pred_list$preds[[which(classifier_files$classifier == "3-feature LASSO")]]


# Compute ROC objects
roc_lambda <- pROC::roc(
  response = lassoRF_preds_lambda$LRTI_adjudication,
  predictor = lassoRF_preds_lambda$pred,
  direction = "<",
  ci = TRUE
)

roc_n3 <- pROC::roc(
  response = lassoRF_preds_n3$LRTI_adjudication,
  predictor = lassoRF_preds_n3$pred,
  direction = "<",
  ci = TRUE
)


# Prepare ROC data frames for ggplot
roc_lambda_df_prot <- data.frame(
  specificity = roc_lambda$specificities,
  sensitivity = roc_lambda$sensitivities,
  classifier  = "Full LASSO"
) %>%
  arrange(specificity, sensitivity)

roc_n3_df_prot <- data.frame(
  specificity = roc_n3$specificities,
  sensitivity = roc_n3$sensitivities,
  classifier  = "3-protein classifier"
) %>%
  arrange(specificity, sensitivity)

roc_combined_prot <- bind_rows(
  roc_lambda_df_prot,
  roc_n3_df_prot
) %>%
  mutate(
    classifier = factor(
      classifier,
      levels = c("Full LASSO", "3-protein classifier")
    )
  )


# Prepare CI ribbon data frames
ci_lambda <- pROC::ci.se(
  roc_lambda,
  specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01)
)

ci_n3 <- pROC::ci.se(
  roc_n3,
  specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01)
)

ci_lambda_df_prot <- data.frame(
  specificity       = as.numeric(rownames(ci_lambda)),
  sensitivity_lower = ci_lambda[, 1],
  sensitivity_upper = ci_lambda[, 3],
  classifier        = "Full LASSO"
) %>%
  arrange(specificity)

ci_n3_df_prot <- data.frame(
  specificity       = as.numeric(rownames(ci_n3)),
  sensitivity_lower = ci_n3[, 1],
  sensitivity_upper = ci_n3[, 3],
  classifier        = "3-protein classifier"
) %>%
  arrange(specificity)

ci_combined_prot <- bind_rows(
  ci_lambda_df_prot,
  ci_n3_df_prot
) %>%
  mutate(
    classifier = factor(
      classifier,
      levels = c("Full LASSO", "3-protein classifier")
    )
  )


# Get pooled AUC values already calculated in 7.3
auc_lambda <- auc_results$results[[which(
  classifier_files$classifier == "Full LASSO"
)]]$pooled

auc_n3 <- auc_results$results[[which(
  classifier_files$classifier == "3-feature LASSO"
)]]$pooled


# Legend labels with AUC values
classifier_labels_prot <- c(
  "Full LASSO" = sprintf(
    "Full LASSO: AUC = %.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
    auc_lambda$auc,
    auc_lambda$lower,
    auc_lambda$upper
  ),
  "3-protein classifier" = sprintf(
    "3-protein classifier: AUC = %.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
    auc_n3$auc,
    auc_n3$lower,
    auc_n3$upper
  )
)


# Create ROC plot
roc_plot_gg_prot <- ggplot() +

  # Diagonal reference line
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 1,
    slope = -1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey80",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Confidence interval ribbons
  geom_ribbon(
    data = ci_combined_prot,
    aes(
      x = specificity,
      ymin = sensitivity_lower,
      ymax = sensitivity_upper,
      fill = classifier,
      group = classifier
    ),
    alpha = 0.12
  ) +

  # ROC curves
  geom_line(
    data = roc_combined_prot,
    aes(
      x = specificity,
      y = sensitivity,
      color = classifier,
      group = classifier
    ),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  # Axes
  scale_x_reverse(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    labels = sprintf("%.1f", seq(0, 1, 0.2))
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +

  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Full LASSO" = "#CC79A7",
      "3-protein classifier" = "#56B4E9"
    ),
    labels = classifier_labels_prot,
    name = NULL
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Full LASSO" = "#CC79A7",
      "3-protein classifier" = "#56B4E9"
    ),
    name = NULL,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  coord_fixed() +

  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Full LASSO vs 3-protein classifier",
    x = "Specificity",
    y = "Sensitivity"
  ) +

  # Theme
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12,
    base_family = "Arial"
  ) +

  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      face = "plain"
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      face = "plain",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      face = "plain"
    ),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    legend.position = c(0.62, 0.18),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    )
  )


print(roc_plot_gg_prot)


# Export as editable vector PDF
ggsave(
  file.path(results_dir, "ROC_lambda_vs_n3_overlaid_prot_gg.pdf"),
  roc_plot_gg_prot,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 6.5,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  bg = "white"
)


# DeLong test
delong_test <- pROC::roc.test(
  roc_lambda,
  roc_n3,
  method = "delong"
)

message(
  "DeLong test p-value: ",
  signif(delong_test$p.value, 3)
)
